bullets.label: Duration
bullets.text: 1 hour, or until the ward is broken

bullets.label: Effect
bullets.text: All divination attempts against you are at -2 while the ward holds

bullets.label: Bonus
bullets.text: You gain +2 on detection rolls (see Sec. 2 above) while warding is active

bullets.label: Limitation
bullets.text: Ward breaks if you suffer injury greater than HP/3 (round down) from a single attack

bullets.label: Effect
bullets.text: On a successful SPI roll, the divination is redirected to a random location or person within 1 mile

bullets.label: Deception
bullets.text: The diviner does not know their spell was misdirected unless they critically succeed

bullets.label: Limitation
bullets.text: Does not work against diviners 2+ Sequences stronger than you
